description: C2: Hode the toll-keeper by his fire where the old road leaves the King's Road (world.marker.warden_keeper), 140 m below the warden's yard: the Broken Warden's tale begins with him. A talker (no faction, protected); not budgeted. Once the keep is opened (world.warden_keep.opened) he has gone up to it with the masons (encounter.aldmere_warden_masons).
